standard_prerequisites.name: The valuative criterion of properness for morphisms of algebraic spaces
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 9175-9176) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces an automorphism of the object over the valuation ring restricting to the given automorphism over the fraction field.

core_obligations: Compare the two 2-morphisms: their composite with the inverse of one another is an automorphism of the object over the fraction field (proof lines 9171-9173)

Extend along the valuation ring: since the Isom sheaf of the object is proper over the base, the valuative criterion provides an automorphism over the valuation ring restricting to that fraction field automorphism (proof lines 9174-9178)

Transport the categories: the proof uses that automorphism to define an equivalence between the two categories of dotted arrows by composing the second component with it, and notes that the final statement is then clear (proof lines 9179-9183)
proof_roadmap: 设 γ, γ′: y∘j → f∘x，则 γ^{-1}∘γ′ 是 y 在 Spec K 上的自同构；由 I_Y → Y proper（故 Isom_Y(y,y) → Spec A proper）与 proper 的赋值判据，存在 δ: y → y 其在 Spec K 上的限制正是 γ^{-1}∘γ′。
用 δ 把「γ 的支点箭头」送到「γ′ 的支点箭头」（(a,α,β) ↦ (a,α,β∘δ)），得两范畴的等价；最后一句由等价性立得。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that when the inertia of the target is proper, the category of dotted arrows in the valuative criterion is independent up to noncanonical equivalence of the choice of the filling 2-morphism, and that the existence of a dotted arrow is equivalent to the existence of a merely 2-commutative triangle (author lemma at source lines 9150-9168, label lemma-cat-dotted-arrows-independent). The proof (source lines 9170-9184) forms the automorphism of the object over the fraction field obtained by comparing the two 2-morphisms, extends it over the valuation ring by the valuative criterion of properness, and uses the extension to define the equivalence between the two categories of dotted arrows (proof lines 9171-9183). The extension step is the content. H2.
